Lecture slides for CS 2010 — Computing Fundamentals.

## Boolean Logic

- [Boolean Logic, Optimized](boolean-opt-slides/index.qmd) — one lecture on
  minimising circuits: what "smaller" means, K-maps, why exact minimisation is
  hard, and the satisfiability problem.
- [Boolean Optimization — handout](boolean-opt-slides/refs.md) — the one-page
  version: identities, K-map rules, SAT vocabulary.

## Programming

- [Seven Machines, One Computer](notional-machines-slides/index.qmd) — one
  lecture on the notional machine: the same job evaluated six times, from
  machine code up to a Clojure logic engine, and what changes at each layer.
